opportunities.title: Catholic Charities – Lorain County Emergency Housing Assistance
opportunities.description: Catholic Charities Lorain County provides emergency rent assistance, eviction prevention services, and housing stability support for individuals and families in crisis. Services include direct rent payment assistance, utility assistance, case management, and referrals to additional community resources. Serves low-income households, single parents, individuals facing eviction, and those experiencing domestic crisis in Lorain County, Ohio.

opportunities.sponsor: The Salvation Army – Northeast Ohio Division
opportunities.description: The Salvation Army Lorain Corps provides emergency financial assistance including rent payments, utility assistance, and eviction prevention for families and individuals in Lorain County. Offers case management and connections to longer-term housing solutions for single parents, low-income households, and individuals facing eviction in Lorain and Elyria, Ohio.

opportunities.sponsor: Love In the Name of Christ – Lorain County

opportunities.title: St. Elizabeth Center – Emergency Shelter & Housing Assistance
opportunities.sponsor: Catholic Charities Diocese of Cleveland – St. Elizabeth Center
opportunities.description: St. Elizabeth Center, operated by Catholic Charities Diocese of Cleveland, provides emergency shelter, transitional housing support, and crisis intervention for individuals and families in Lorain County. Services include emergency housing placement, rent assistance referrals, case management for housing stability, and connections to long-term housing solutions. Specializes in serving women, single mothers with children, and individuals fleeing domestic violence or experiencing housing crisis in Elyria and Lorain County, Ohio.

opportunities.title: Emmanuel Lutheran Church – Community Outreach Emergency Housing Assistance
opportunities.description: Emmanuel Lutheran Church in Elyria, Ohio provides community outreach services including emergency rent assistance, housing support, and crisis aid for residents of Lorain County. Their community outreach program helps individuals and families facing eviction, behind on rent, or experiencing housing instability with direct financial assistance and referrals. Available to single parents, low-income households, and individuals in domestic crisis situations in the Elyria and greater Lorain County area.

opportunities.title: St. Mary Parish Helping Hands – Emergency Rent & Housing Assistance
opportunities.description: St. Mary Parish Helping Hands ministry in Elyria, Ohio provides emergency financial assistance for rent payments, utility bills, and housing stability support through their social outreach ministries. The program serves individuals and families in Lorain County who are behind on rent, facing eviction, or experiencing housing crisis. Assistance is available to single parents, low-income households, and those impacted by domestic separation or job loss in the Elyria and Lorain County, Ohio area.
